title: pv-residual-rl: network-aware rooftop PV subsidy planning with an exact allocation layer and residual reinforcement learning

creators.name: Jafari, Hesam
creators.affiliation: School of Industrial Engineering, Iran University of Science and Technology

creators.name: Sahebi, Hadi
creators.affiliation: School of Industrial Engineering, Iran University of Science and Technology

description:
Simulator, baselines, experiment scripts, per-scenario results and trained models for the multi-year allocation of a rooftop-PV subsidy budget across the 32 neighbourhoods of an IEEE 33-bus feeder under uncertain acceptance, demand growth and irradiance (19 years of PVGIS data for Tehran).

The package contains the LinDistFlow planning environment with an optional substation tap changer, an exact expected-capacity allocation layer, rule-based, rolling-horizon and lookahead baselines, plain and residual PPO agents, the paired evaluation protocol, OpenDSS re-evaluation scripts and a wait-and-see bound. All results in the repository are reproduced by the scripts in scripts/; see README.md and docs/decisions.md.
